summary: Manage capped whole-node memory budgets across Bitcoin and balance-history bootstrap phases
details: New setup and configure flows default to proportional automatic allocation with independently configurable Bitcoin and balance-history ceilings for 32 GB and larger hosts.
The controller releases old allocations before overlapping historical indexing, demotes Bitcoin after stable full readiness, and resumes interrupted transitions from verified container settings.
Snapshot import remains independent of resource polling, and completed imports are preserved across cache and memory changes.
Configuration checks reject incompatible balance-history cache budgets before snapshot import; resource phases and planned restarts are visible in node status.
operator_actions: Use usdb-node resources --json to preview all phase budgets and setup/configure --bh-memory-cap to set a balance-history ceiling.
Existing configurations retain manual mode. Stop the node before using set-resource-policy --mode auto to opt into managed restarts and persist the new budget.
Inspect node.resources.json and controller logs if a resource transition is interrupted; retain the existing data directories.
